# Eventual

> Eventual is a free web app for splitting group expenses in Indian rupees (and other currencies). Log what everyone paid on trips, in shared flats and on nights out; Eventual splits each bill evenly, by exact amounts, by shares or by percent, and tells each person exactly who to pay and how much, down to the last paisa.

Key facts:

- Free to use. No paid plans.
- Groups are private: only invited members see a group's expenses, balances and history.
- Shares always add up: INR 1,000 split three ways is INR 333.34, 333.33 and 333.33.
- Once someone marks their share paid, the expense locks so the settled amount can't change.
- Balances are simplified into as few transfers as possible. Each currency is kept separate; amounts are never converted.
- Eventual records who owes whom. It does not move money.
- Expenses can be logged from the web app, an Apple Shortcut (iPhone, iPad, Mac, Watch, Siri), any MCP-capable AI assistant, or the REST API.

## Help

- [Help center](https://eventual.macintushar.xyz/help): FAQ on groups, invites, roles, split methods, locked expenses, settling up, password reset and integrations
- [How do I create a group?](https://eventual.macintushar.xyz/help/create-a-group): step-by-step guide with screenshots
- [How do I add an expense?](https://eventual.macintushar.xyz/help/add-an-expense): step-by-step guide covering split methods

## Integrations

- [Integrations](https://eventual.macintushar.xyz/docs): Apple Shortcut download and MCP setup for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Hermes and OpenClaw
- MCP server: `https://eventual.macintushar.xyz/mcp` (Streamable HTTP). Authenticate with `x-api-key: <your-api-key>` or `Authorization: Bearer <your-api-key>`, using an API key created at https://eventual.macintushar.xyz/app/settings/api-keys
- MCP tools: `listGroups` (your groups and balance in each), `listExpenses` (recent expenses in a group), `createExpense` (log an expense with any split method), `getBalances` (who owes whom, with simplified transfers)
- [OpenAPI spec](https://eventual.macintushar.xyz/api/openapi.json): the REST API under `/api/v1`, same API-key authentication
